main.content: {{Infobox Location |name = Chasm of Fire |image = [[File:Chasm of Fire.png|300px]] |release = [[27 April]] [[2017]] |update = Diverse Dungeons |members = Yes |floors = Three |location = [[Great Kourend]] |race = [[Demons]], [[Humans]] |music = [[Darkness in the Depths]] |map = [[File:Chasm of Fire dungeon map.png]] |type = dungeon |leagueRegion = Kourend }} {{Map|name=Chasm of Fire|height=250|width=250|x=1435|y=3668|align=right|zoom=2|caption=Location of the entrance.}} [[File:Chasm of Fire entrance.png|thumb|right|The entrance to the dungeon.]] The '''Chasm of Fire''' is a [[dungeons|dungeon]] located in the north-west corner of [[Shayzien]], housing a variety of [[demons]] led by [[Yama]], the Master of Pacts. After completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]], a group of five Shayzien soldiers (a [[Lieutenant (Chasm of Fire)|lieutenant]], [[Sergeant (Chasm of Fire)|sergeant]], and three [[Soldier (Chasm of Fire)|soldiers]]) will be found loitering around the entrance. Likewise, the player can access [[Yama's Domain]] by speaking to the [[Voice of Yama]] at the bottom level of the chasm. Players can use the [[Lift (Chasm of Fire)|lifts]] to travel between floors. Two shortcuts can be found in the dungeon; one at the entrance, requiring 83 [[Agility]] and another by the first lift, requiring 73 Agility. The first shortcut drops players off on the third floor by the Voice of Yama, while the second shortcut takes players to the [[greater demon]] area and leads to another two shortcuts leading to the lift to the third floor. These shortcuts are one-way only. A [[dwarf multicannon]] can be used in the chasm, although it is not a multi-combat area. There are several safespots for killing greater demons on the middle floor, by utilising the piles of rocks and the narrow pathways. [[Resurrection spells]] cannot be cast whilst within the Chasm of Fire (excluding Yama's arena) with the message "You can't resurrect a thrall here." appearing when attempting to do so. ==Transportation== There are several ways to reach the dungeon: * A [[chasm teleport scroll]] brings players inside the dungeon on the bottom floor (only if you've previously been to [[Great Kourend]]). * The [[Fairy rings|Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|DJR}} will bring the players just south-east of the Chasm (only if you've previously been to Great Kourend). * Using [[Kharedst's memoirs]] to teleport to the [[Graveyard of Heroes]] via reminiscing "History and Hearsay". Requires completion of [[Tale of the Righteous]]. * Using [[Battlefront teleport]] brings players just north-west of the chasm. * Using a [[skills necklace]] to teleport to the [[Farming Guild]], and then running south-east. A form of [[antipoison]] is recommended due to [[lizardmen]] on the way. {{clear|left}} ==Contracts== {{Main|Yama#Contracts}} [[Yama]] can be offered contracts to alter the nature of the fight. Resource/material contracts can only be acquired from a dossier, which Yama uncommonly drops. The combat contracts for the purifying sigil can be acquired from both this dossier and killing Yama's demons in various manners. Similar in function to awakener's orbs, these contracts are tradeable and are consumed upon attempting the fight. Upon speaking to Yama and signing a contract with him, the demons in the dungeon have a chance to drop contracts for the [[purifying sigil]]; the other contracts are not available in this manner, and are instead obtained from the [[dossier]], which Yama infrequently drops. ===Sigils=== After signing [[Yama|Yama's]] initial contract, attacking any demon in this location will cause a Green, Blue, Yellow, Red, or Purple sigil to appear over their head, indicating the preferred method Yama wants them to die. Satisfying this request, by using a specific weapon type for the killing blow, will '''double the drop chance''' of the contract associated with that weapon. Satisfying the yellow sigil via a special attack boosts the drop rate by 5x instead, as [[Special attacks#Energy|special attack energy]] is a finite resource.{{PlainCiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/a=13/yama-the-master-of-pacts-out-today?oldschool=1|title=Yama, the Master of Pacts: Out Today|newsdate=14 May 2025|quote=Red: Kill a demon with a Special attack. This one has better odds at giving you a contract than the others, since Special Attack is a finite resource.}} As long as this sigil system has been activated by Yama, players may use any valid weapon to selectively farm any desired contract at unboosted rates. If a weapon counts for any of these categories, the demon will drop double ashes to inform the player that the style is valid. {{bug|The active sigil above a demon's head currently does not correlate with the doubled ash drop. A valid kill for ''any'' sigil, not just the active one, will yield double ashes.}} The active sigil is unique to each player, and has a chance to change after 32 kills of any type of demon in the Chasm. This includes kills not made under the active condition, but excludes kills that were a result of indirect damage (e.g., [[poison]] or [[burn|burns]]). Sigil streaks ''(32 kills in the same style)'' can repeat the same colour multiple times in a row. It is not affected by switching worlds or by real time. If the player is unsure of what method is needed, they can speak to the [[Disciple of Yama]] to learn of the preferred method. {| class="wikitable" !Sigil !Condition !Potential contract reward !Ideal method |- |[[File:Chasm of Fire sigil (Green).png|alt=green sigil|center]] |Kill the demon with [[Heavy Ranged weapons]]; e.g., [[crossbow]]s, [[ballista|ballistae]], [[Chinchompa (weapon)|chinchompas]]. |[[File:Contract of Divine Severance.png]] [[Contract of Divine Severance]] |[[Hunters' sunlight crossbow]] or [[Karil's crossbow]] (both 3-tick heavy ranged crossbows on rapid) with dwarf multicannon.{{efn|A [[Dwarf multicannon]] deals heavy ranged damage.}} |- |[[File:Chasm of Fire sigil (Blue).png|alt=blue sigil|center]] |Kill the demon with a spell; e.g [[Dark Demonbane]] or any other manually/autocastable spell. Powered staves, such as [[Tumeken's shadow]], '''will not count''' for this method. Damaging bind spells '''will also not count''' for this method, as they are for a different method. |[[File:Contract of Sensory Clouding.png]] [[Contract of Sensory Clouding]] |Best [[demonbane spells|demonbane spell]] available; if not, use [[water spells]], as demons have a 40% water weakness. |- |[[File:Chasm of Fire sigil (Yellow).png|alt=yellow sigil|center]] |Kill the demon with a [[special attacks|special attack]].{{efn|Attacks that trigger Enchanted Bolt Special effects can count as special attacks}} |[[File:Contract of Glyphic Attenuation.png]] [[Contract of Glyphic Attenuation]] |[[Purging staff]] (special attack costs 25%, is refunded if attack kills demon){{PlainCiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/a=13/yama-cas--more?oldschool=1|title=Yama CAs & More!|newsdate=29 May 2025|quote=The Purging Staff Special Attack now counts towards Contract of Glyphic Attenuation.}} or [[Soulreaper axe]]{{CiteReddit|author=Mod Goblin|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/2007scape/comments/1kmb5wq/comment/ms8tvb0/|title=Yama, the Master of Pacts - Out Today!|quote=[Does using the Soulreaper Axe special attack satisfy the contract requirements for killing demons with special attack's in Yama’s domain?] Coded as a regular spec so it should do!|date=14 May 2025|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/LfvMy|archivedate=26 May 2025}} (can special every other attack) Otherwise, use a low energy cost weapon such as [[burning claws]], [[dragon dagger]], or [[Osmumten's fang]]. [[Death Charge]] and [[lightbearer]] make this kill method far more consistent. |- |[[File:Chasm of Fire sigil (Red).png|alt=red sigil|center]] |Kill the demon with a two-handed [[melee]] weapon of any sort (claws, halberd, mauls, two-handed swords, etc.) {{efn|It's unknown if using multiple methods at the same time, e.g a 2-handed special attack, counts as a single style, or multiple.}} |[[File:Contract of Bloodied Blows.png]] [[Contract of Bloodied Blows]] |Use a 4 or 5-tick two-handed [[melee]] weapon such as [[Scythe of Vitur]], [[noxious halberd]], [[abyssal bludgeon]], [[zamorakian spear]], burning claws, etc. |- |[[File:Chasm of Fire sigil (Purple).png|alt=purple sigil|center]] |Kill the demon while it is [[bind|bound]] or by a damaging bind spell (e.g [[grasp spells]]) |[[File:Contract of Forfeit Breath.png]] [[Contract of Forfeit Breath]] | *[[Ice Barrage]] (binds for 19.2 seconds, or 21.0 with an [[Ice ancient sceptre]]). Freeze the demon when it reaches ~30% or less hitpoints. *[[Undead Grasp]] (damaging bind spell, bind time is negligible) *The [[scorching bow]]'s special attack binds a demon for 12.0 seconds at the cost of 25% special attack energy |} {{notelist}} ==Mining== On the third level of the dungeon, by the gibbet connecting the two floors, is a small [[Mining]] and [[Smithing]] area containing [[infernal shale rocks]] and [[infernal shale deposit]]s, which can be mined at level 78 (boostable). [[Jim]], an [[imp]] overseeing the area, will provide players with a [[Jim's wet cloth|piece of cloth]] that they can use to mine faster. A [[Furnace (Chasm of Fire)|furnace]] and [[Anvil (Chasm of Fire)|anvil]] can also be found in the area which is used to process [[crushed infernal shale]] and [[oathplate shards]] at level 83 Smithing (boostable) to begin the process of creating [[oathplate armour]]. ==Personalities== *[[Disciple of Yama]] *[[Voice of Yama]] *[[Jim]] ==Monsters== Monsters found in the Chasm of Fire include: {{LocationMonsterTableHead|showslayer=yes}} {{LocationMonsterTableLine|name=Lesser demon|levels=82|slayerlevel=1|slayerxp=79|spawns=9}} {{LocationMonsterTableLine|name=Greater demon|levels=92|slayerlevel=1|slayerxp=87|spawns=17}} {{LocationMonsterTableLine|name=Black demon|levels=172|slayerlevel=1|slayerxp=157|spawns=16}} {{LocationMonsterTableBottom}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 29 May 2025 |update = Yama CAs & More! |change = * Contract overhead icons have been switched around to use appropriately-themed colours instead; previously, they used the following colours for the following methods: purple for Ranged, green for Magic, blue for melee, yellow for binding spells, and red for special attacks. * Agility shortcut icons erroneously present on the bottom floor map have been removed. }} {{Subject changes |date = 22 May 2025 |update = Yama: The Calm Before the Contract Storm |change = Doubled the drop rate of contracts from the lesser, greater and black demons. }} {{Subject changes |date = 14 May 2025 |update = Yama, the Master of Pacts: Out Today |change = Added Yama, a new lower floor, and agility shortcuts requiring 73 and 83 Agility respectively. Demons in the dungeon no longer require a Slayer task in order to be killed. }} {{Subject changes |date = 4 May 2017 |update = Skotos & Dark Claws |change = A duplicated entrance option on the Chasm of Fire has been removed. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== [[File:Chasm of Fire odd map.png|thumb|right|The hidden level within the Chasm of Fire, appearing to spell out "CHASM OF FIRE".]] *Before [[Update:Yama, the Master of Pacts: Out Today|an update]] that remodeled the Chasm, players could use an [[oculus orb]], to see a hidden level beneath the bottom level. This level is inaccessible. When asked about this, Mod West stated "Figured I'd leave the bottom floor available, y'know, just in case."{{CiteForum|author = Mod West|url = https://www.reddit.com/r/2007scape/comments/67wfpd/chasm_of_fire_easter_egg_osbuddy_map_floor_0/dgts9y1/|title = Chasm of Fire easter egg (OSBuddy map floor 0)|forum = Reddit|postdate = April 27, 2017}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Slayer locations}} {{Chasm of Fire}} {{Great Kourend}} {{Dungeons}}
